input.input_needs_description:
I generate one global background music track for the whole film. I pick the mood from any available content source — screenplay, video analysis, or the user's brief — whichever is wired up.

[screenplay] (single)
The screenplay — I read its overall mood/tone (genre / tone_keywords / per-shot descriptive text) to pick a film-wide music style.

[video_analysis] (single)
A scene-level video-analysis report — scenes with mood and a video_summary.genre. I aggregate scene moods into a single film-wide mood.

[creative_brief] (single)
The user's verbatim natural-language brief for the whole pipeline (auto-persisted from chat / text upload). Often the most direct mood signal — the user names instruments / atmosphere directly ('gentle slow piano score', 'tense orchestral theme', 'lullaby BGM'). Read alongside [screenplay] / [video_analysis]; any one of the three is enough.
